note: Human Cardoso-Moreira 2019 liver has only 4 young + 7 old postnatal samples. Per-gene FDR correction is underpowered for human, so the pig-anchored analysis (pig FDR<0.10, |FC|>0.5 in both, no human FDR) is the primary result.

criteria.human_test: Welch t-test (more power for n=4 vs n=7)

strict_analysis.description: FDR<0.10 and |FC|>0.5 in BOTH species (as in muscle)
strict_analysis.result: Insufficient genes due to low human sample size

pig_anchored_analysis.description: Pig FDR<0.10, |FC|>0.5 in both species (no human FDR filter)

relaxed_analysis.description: Pig FDR<0.10, |FC|>0.5 in both, human raw p<0.05

all_genes_analysis.description: All overlapping genes, no significance filter (reference)
